Itinerary

Three days, two tee times

Fly up on the Thursday afternoon, ease in with a night in Aberdeen, then two mornings back-to-back on the links with an 11 o’clock start each day. Home in time for the late news on Saturday.

Day 1

Heathrow to Aberdeen

Thursday 15 April

  • 14:55Depart London Heathrow on British Airways — flights already booked, golf bags checked.
  • Late pmArrive Aberdeen and head into the city centre.
  • EveningCheck in at Sandman Signature Aberdeen. First night out in town.

Day 2

The Old Course

Friday 16 April

  • MorningBreakfast, then transfer north to Trump International at the Menie Estate (about 15 minutes).
  • 11:00Tee off · Old Course. 18 holes through the highest dunes on the estate.
  • AfternoonCheck in at MacLeod House & Lodge, on the estate.
  • EveningWhisky tasting at the resort, included.

Day 3

The New Course

Saturday 17 April

  • MorningBreakfast at MacLeod House and check out.
  • 11:06Tee off · New Course. Opened July 2025 — most of us will be playing it for the first time.
  • Late pmTransfer to Aberdeen Airport, 15 minutes from the estate.
  • 19:20Depart Aberdeen for London Heathrow.

The courses

36 holes in the Great Dunes of Scotland

Trump International sits on the Menie Estate at Balmedie, ten minutes north of Aberdeen. Two championship links run through the same stretch of coastal dunes and share a clubhouse, a 22-acre range and a 32,500 sq ft putting green.

Friday · 11:00

Round one

The Old Course

Two classic out-and-back loops of nine, woven through what the club calls the greatest sand dunes anywhere in the world. Natural amphitheatres of golden-tipped grass, panoramic sea views, and a slope rating that tells you everything about the rough.

Opened2012
Yardage7,452yds
Par72
Rating / Slope78 / 153

Architect: Dr Martin Hawtree. Stroke index 1: the 4th, a 563-yard par 5 off the black tees.

Saturday · 11:06

Round two

The New Course

Cavernous sandy hollows, expansive native wetlands, historic relics and towering windswept mountains of marram grass. Opened on 29 July 2025 and already talked about as one of the great modern links. There is a halfway house called Dram in the Dunes, which feels relevant.

Opened2025
Yardage7,589yds
Par72
Rating / Slope77 / 148

Design: led by Eric Trump, building on Hawtree’s original masterplan. Stroke index 1: the 4th again, a 448-yard par 4.

Where we’re staying

City first, estate second

One night in Aberdeen itself so we can get out on the Thursday evening, then a night on the golf estate so the walk from breakfast to the first tee is a short one.

Night 1 · Thursday

Sandman Signature Aberdeen

A converted granite building on St Andrew Street in the middle of the city. Big rooms, a restaurant and bar downstairs, and Union Street within a few minutes’ walk. Bed and breakfast.

St Andrew Street, Aberdeen city centre

Night 2 · Friday

Trump MacLeod House & Lodge

Formerly Menie House, a Scots baronial mansion designed around 1835 by Aberdeen city architect John “Tudor Johnny” Smith, now the estate’s boutique hotel. The estate has its own Clavis Whisky Bar, so the included tasting is in good hands. Bed and breakfast.

Menie Estate, Balmedie, Aberdeenshire AB23 8YE
